info.title: Al-Ameen Clinical Speech Therapy Academy API
info.description:
Comprehensive RESTful API (v1) for all Public, Authentication, and Student Workspace features of the Al-Ameen Clinical Speech Therapy LMS Platform. Built on a unified Service Layer shared 100% between Web (Blade/Livewire) and API.

### Localization
Send `Accept-Language: ar` or `Accept-Language: en` (or `X-Locale: ar|en` / `?lang=ar|en`) on any request to receive localized fields and validation messages.

### Authentication
Protected endpoints require a Laravel Sanctum Bearer Token in the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header. Student accounts must have `status = active` (approved by administration) to authenticate and access student workspace endpoints.
